summary: Eagle Point Trinity Senior Secured Lending Co filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of 36,782.83 common shares for aggregate proceeds of $373,000, or ~$10.14 per share based on May 31 NAV. The shares were issued under subscription agreements exempt from registration per Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D. The filing also disclosed the May NAV. No tender offer, restructuring, or special situation is present; this is a routine capital raise by a BDC.
